newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block to expand beyond taxes - report.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block to expand beyond taxes - report.

text.p: H&R Block Inc is seeking to expand into businesses outside income tax preparation by offering home mortgages and marketing software, the New York Times reported on Sunday.

The paper reported that H&R Block, which handles 12 percent of the professionally prepared tax returns in the United States, is expanding its mortgage origination business to more than 30 tax preparation stores in Colorado, Indiana, North Carolina and Virginia.
Analysts told the paper, however, that the company's push into other services will require an increased investment in consumer marketing for the company to broaden its reach.
The company is also marketing software, such as Kiplinger's Tax Cut, Home Legal Adviser and Small Business Attorney, the paper said.
H&R Block's stock has lagged the S&P 500 Index and its 80 percent owned CompuServe Corp unit has been hurt by increased competition among online services and Internet providers, the paper said.
International growth should also aid H&R Block as tax systems change abroad, the paper said.
